task.name: Triangle-free diameter-four augmentation
task.description: construct() -> list of added undirected edges [u,v] on vertices 0..23. Existing edges and duplicate edges are forbidden. The union with the pinned path must remain triangle-free, connected and have diameter at most four. Minimize the number of added edges. The host is a locally chosen 24-vertex path. Its h_4 upper bounds do not establish the maximum over all triangle-free hosts or the paper’s asymptotic claims.
